image_description: Two red Apple iPod Classic devices placed side-by-side on a neutral grey surface. The device on the left is shorter and wider (likely an earlier generation or different model variant), while the device on the right is taller and narrower. Both feature white click wheels with 'MENU', play/pause, and skip icons, and LCD screens displaying music library menus with artist names.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation and ensure the device is correctly classified as an iPod and not a generic MP3 player clone.
To verify that the artist names and menu items are rendered with correct spelling and font consistency, checking for AI text gibberish.
To ensure the click wheel is perfectly circular and flush with the casing, and that there are no edge bleeding artifacts between the red body and the grey background.
To verify that the shadows cast by the devices are consistent with a single light source and that the perspective lines of the rectangular bodies are parallel and realistic.

focus_areas: Text legibility and spelling on LCD screens
Geometric perfection of the click wheel circles
Edge sharpness between device and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the screens. AI generators often fail to render long lists of names without introducing subtle typos or character deformations. Also, check if the aspect ratios of the two iPods correspond to real historical models (e.g., iPod Classic vs. iPod Video) or if they are morphologically inconsistent hybrids.
